name: Nacho Cheese Protein Puffs (TPI Foods)

source.author: TPI Marketing / TPI Foods (code TNC 16126)
source.notes: Store-bought packaged snack. Values transcribed directly from the Nutrition Facts + amino-acid panels (photos 2026-08-09) — LABEL-VERIFIED, not estimated. Best before 06/10/2027. Contains milk (allergen).

ingredients.item: nonfat dry milk, whey protein solids, buttermilk powder/solids
onion powder, garlic powder, chili, spices, paprika, cayenne
maltodextrin, citric acid, silicon dioxide, tricalcium phosphate, caseinate, annatto

steps: Packaged snack — eat straight from the jar, or use as a salad/soup crouton-style topper.

him.verdict: An elite snack on macros: 21 g protein for 130 kcal is ~16 g protein per 100 kcal — about as protein-dense as food gets — with near-zero carb, no sugar, low fat, and a complete milk-protein amino profile (~1.8 g leucine/serving, right at the muscle-protein-synthesis threshold). Ideal for hitting protein on a cut. Two knocks keep it off a 9: ~390 mg sodium/serving (17% DV — watch multi-cup grazing) and it's ultra-processed with 0 fiber and no sperm-priority micros.
suggested_mods: Great as a 1-cup protein-topper on a salad (adds crunch + protein without carbs) — the label's own suggestion, and it fixes the 0-fiber issue by pairing with greens
Cap at ~1–2 cups so sodium stays reasonable
Strong candidate to adopt as a go-to high-protein snack — say the word and I'll flag it

her_preconception.verdict: A fine high-protein, high-calcium snack for her — 21 g complete protein plus 280 mg calcium (20% DV) and a little vitamin D, all genuine preconception positives. But it's ultra-processed, high-sodium, and brings no folate or iron, so it's a protein/calcium top-up rather than a nutrient-dense choice. No pregnancy safety flags (dairy is pasteurized). Note: contains milk.
prenatal_highlights: 21 g complete protein per 30 g serving
calcium 280 mg (20% DV) + vitamin D 1.4 mcg — bone/prenatal support

safety_advisories.note: Ultra-processed, high sodium (390 mg/serving) — fine in moderation; keep portions modest during pregnancy.
safety_advisories.swap: pair with fresh veg; limit to 1 cup

suggested_mods: Use as an occasional protein/calcium top-up, not a staple
Pair with fruit or veg to add the fiber/folate it lacks

adopted_note: Promoted to the rotation 2026-08-09 as a fixed go-to high-protein snack. Label-verified, so reuse the per-serving values directly (1 cup / 30 g = 130 kcal, 21 g protein). Standing guidance: cap at ~1–2 cups (sodium), ideally as a salad topper to add the fiber/veg it lacks.
